  • WA C Class Driver’s Licence.

job.title: Pre Construction Manager
job.description:
Pre-Construction Manager
Melbourne, VIC | Permanent Full-Time
 
The Opportunity
Design & Build Recruitment is partnering with a well-established and growing electrical services contractor to appoint an experienced Pre-Construction Manager.
This is a key leadership position sitting at the intersection of Estimating, Design and Operations, taking ownership of projects from early contractor involvement and tender stage through to procurement, delivery planning and operational handover.
 
The role will suit an experienced Project Manager, Senior Estimator, Pre-Construction Manager or Engineer who understands the realities of delivering complex construction projects and enjoys influencing outcomes before construction begins.
With a strong pipeline of major projects and continued business growth, this position offers the opportunity to establish and develop a dedicated pre-construction function, with the expectation that the successful candidate will eventually lead a team.
 
The Role
As Pre-Construction Manager, you will play a critical role in ensuring projects transition effectively from concept and tender through to delivery.
Working closely with senior leadership, estimators, designers and project delivery teams, you will lead ECI and bid opportunities, review major project estimates, identify commercial and technical risks, and develop operational budgets and production metrics ahead of project commencement.
You will remain involved through early design and procurement, ensuring a structured and commercially robust handover into operations.
 
Key Responsibilities
Tender & Estimating
  • Lead and coordinate ECI and major bid opportunities alongside estimating and design teams.
  • Review significant project estimates through to final negotiation stages.
  • Provide input into buildability, constructability and design reviews.
  • Support labour rate build-ups, schedules of rates and standardised estimating information.
  • Provide technical and commercial advice around client budgets, design and project strategy.
  • Support business development activity and major tender opportunities.
Pre-Construction & Project Planning
  • Translate awarded project estimates into operational budgets and production metrics.
  • Undertake detailed reviews of project scope, design and documentation ahead of delivery.
  • Establish and manage project Risk & Opportunity registers.
  • Identify value engineering and design efficiency opportunities.
  • Coordinate early procurement of long-lead and engineered equipment.
  • Lead formal project handovers from pre-construction into operational delivery teams.
  • Coordinate early design engagement with clients and internal design teams.
Project Delivery Support
  • Maintain involvement through early design and procurement stages.
  • Support project teams during the transition into construction.
  • Drive lessons learned and continuous improvement across project delivery.
Leadership & Process Improvement
  • Improve pre-construction processes, systems, templates and reporting.
  • Maintain accurate records across estimates, budgets and handover documentation.
  • Provide reporting on pipeline opportunities, project handovers and key lessons learned.
  • Play a key role in developing the future pre-construction function, with the opportunity to build and lead a team.
About You
We are looking for someone with a strong understanding of the construction lifecycle and the ability to bridge the gap between winning work and successfully delivering it.
You may currently be working as a:
  • Pre-Construction Manager
  • Senior Project Manager
  • Project Manager with strong estimating experience
  • Senior Estimator looking to move closer to project strategy and delivery
  • Electrical or Building Services Engineer with significant commercial project experience
Ideally, you will bring:
  • Experience in project management and/or engineering combined with estimating experience within the construction industry.
  • A strong understanding of buildability, constructability and design review.
  • Experience across the full project lifecycle, from ECI and tender through to design, procurement and project handover.
  • The ability to review complex scopes and identify commercial, technical and delivery risks.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to work across estimating, design, operations and client teams.
  • Experience identifying value engineering and design efficiency opportunities.
  • Excellent analytical, commercial and problem-solving skills.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
Experience within electrical services, building services, industrial construction, infrastructure or mission-critical/data centre environments will be highly regarded.
 
What's On Offer?
This is a genuine opportunity to take ownership of a critical function within a growing contractor.
You will have:
  • A highly influential role across major projects.
  • Package: $180,000 - $220,000 + super + vehicle/car allowance (DOE)
  • Exposure to projects from tender through to delivery.
  • The opportunity to shape and improve pre-construction processes.
  • Close collaboration with senior leadership.
  • A clear pathway into building and leading a dedicated pre-construction team.
  • A strong pipeline of complex electrical and infrastructure projects.
  • A permanent, long-term career opportunity with a growing Melbourne-based contractor.
Apply
If you are an experienced construction professional looking to move into a strategic pre-construction leadership role, we'd like to hear from you.
For a confidential discussion, please contact Connor Gwilliam at Design & Build Recruitment, or apply directly via the link below.
All applications will be treated in the strictest confidence.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
Project Manager

Design & Build Recruitment is searching for a quality Project Manager, who has the desire to work for a reputable and national Tier 3 full D&C commercial construction company. With a reputation for delivering excellence, our focus on projects ranging from $15M to $40M.

The Role
We are seeking an experienced and driven Project Manager. You will be involved in new build projects in the most part. However, time to time, you could be required to assist on Fitout projects in between New Build projects. The bonus is that you will have quality job security. You will be responsible for managing the end-to-end delivery of one or multiple projects depending on size and scope.

The ideal applicant will either be an established Project Manager who has experience delivering new build projects, or a Project Engineer from the Teir 1 space looking for an opportunity to work as a Project Manager.

  • Oversee the planning, execution, and delivery of projects valued between $15M and $40M.
  • Manage project timelines, budgets, and resources to ensure successful outcomes.
  • Collaborate with clients, stakeholders, and subcontractors to achieve project goals.
  • Lead and mentor project teams, fostering a positive and productive work environment.
  • Ensure compliance with safety, quality, and regulatory standards throughout project lifecycles.

job.title: Commissioning Technician
job.description:
Industrial Electrician – Testing & Commissioning
Location: Eastern Creek, NSW
Employment Type: Full Time | Permanent
Salary: $60–$65 per hour (depending on experience)

We are seeking an experienced Industrial Electrician to join our growing team based in Eastern Creek.

This is an exciting opportunity for a motivated electrician with strong commissioning and testing experience to work on fuel system installations and associated control systems across a range of  industrial sites throughout Sydney.

If you enjoy solving technical challenges, working with modern automation systems, and being part of a supportive team delivering high-quality projects, we'd love to hear from you.

As an Industrial Electrician, you will be responsible for the testing, commissioning and ongoing support of electrical systems associated with fuel infrastructure projects.
Key Responsibilities
  • As an Electrician you will carry out testing and commissioning electrical systems.
  • This Electrician will assist with the commissioning of fuel systems and associated ancillary equipment.
  • The Electrician will carry out fault finding, diagnostics and system verification.
  • Testing and commissioning control systems.
  • Working with low voltage electrical installations.
  • Assisting with PLC commissioning and basic programming modifications.
  • Reading and interpreting electrical drawings and control schematics.
  • Providing post-commissioning technical support and troubleshooting.
  • Completing commissioning documentation and compliance records.
  • Travelling to customer sites across the Sydney metropolitan area.
About You To be successful in this role, you will have:
  • NSW Electrical Trade Qualification and current Electrical Licence (or relevant Engineering Degree with applicable experience).
  • Proven experience in testing and commissioning industrial electrical systems.
  • Experience commissioning control systems and ancillary equipment.
  • Sound knowledge of low voltage electrical systems.
  • Experience with PLCs, including basic programming and fault finding.
  • Strong troubleshooting and diagnostic skills.
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics and technical documentation.
  • Excellent communication and customer service skills.
  • Current Australian Driver's Licence.
  • Ability to travel to various sites throughout Sydney.
What's on Offer
  • $60–$65 per hour, depending on experience.
  • Permanent full-time position.
  • Diverse and technically challenging work.
  • Opportunity to work on major fuel infrastructure projects.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Supportive and experienced team environment.
  • Long-term career progression with a growing business.

job.title: Estimator
job.description:
Join a Canberra construction business

An established and growing construction business is looking for an experienced Estimator to join its Canberra team.

This is an opportunity to step into a key role within a collaborative team, working across a diverse range of projects and playing an important part in securing and delivering future work.

The Role
As an Estimator, you will be responsible for preparing accurate and competitive tenders across a range of commercial construction projects. You’ll work closely with the pre-construction and delivery teams, subcontractors and suppliers to ensure projects are priced accurately and strategically.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Preparing detailed and accurate cost estimates and tenders
  • Reviewing plans, specifications, scopes and contract documentation
  • Preparing subcontractor and supplier packages and managing the tender process
  • Obtaining and analysing subcontractor and supplier quotations
  • Identifying project risks, exclusions, variations and opportunities
  • Developing accurate construction methodologies and preliminary costs
  • Preparing tender submissions and supporting documentation
  • Liaising with clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers
  • Working closely with Project Managers and the wider construction team
  • Maintaining strong relationships with subcontractors and suppliers across the ACT market
About You
We’re looking for an Estimator who combines strong technical estimating skills with a commercial mindset and a good understanding of the Canberra construction market.

You will ideally have:
  • Previous experience as an Estimator within the commercial construction industry
  • Strong knowledge of construction methodologies, materials and processes
  • The ability to interpret architectural, structural and services drawings
  • Experience preparing tenders from initial review through to submission
  • Strong subcontractor and supplier relationships
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
  • Strong communication and negotiation skills
  • The ability to manage multiple tenders and deadlines simultaneously
  • Relevant construction, quantity surveying or estimating qualifications are advantageous
  • You must be an Australian Citizen to apply for this role. 
What's on Offer?
  • Join an established and growing Canberra construction business
  • Work across a diverse range of interesting projects
  • Supportive and collaborative team environment
  • Genuine opportunity for career progression
  • Competitive salary package, based on experience
  • Opportunity to play a key role in the company's continued growth

job.title: Maintenance Technician
job.description:
Maintenance Technician — Sterile Injectables

Location: Chatswood, NSW
Industry: Pharmaceutical Manufacturing (Sterile Injectables)
Hours: Monday–Friday, 8am–4pm (training period), transitioning to rotating 8am–4pm / 7am–3pm shifts
Salary: $100,000–$115,000 + phone + discretionary bonus

 About the Company

Our client is an Australian-owned pharmaceutical manufacturer supplying hospitals nationally and exporting to international markets, with active plans for further global expansion. While smaller than the multinational giants, the business offers genuine access to senior leadership — including regular contact with the CEO — and continued investment in new machinery and cleanroom infrastructure.

This is a business with a strong retention track record: the maintenance team has very low turnover, with tenures ranging from 3 to 20+ years. You'll be joining a close-knit, growing team of 4.

About the Role

We're looking for a hands-on Maintenance Technician to join the site's maintenance team, working across cleanroom and aseptic suite environments supporting liquid filling and sterile injectable manufacturing. This is a step up for someone with tablet/solid-dose maintenance experience looking to move into liquid/sterile processing — or a great fit for someone already working in sterile injectables.

You'll partner closely with a senior technician during onboarding before moving onto the standard rotating roster.

Reporting to: Asset Manager (who reports to the Chief Operations Manager, then CEO)

Key Responsibilities

- Perform preventative maintenance on equipment, critical systems, and services — including purified water systems, cleanroom/aseptic suite systems, vision systems, blister and packaging equipment, and vial-based theatre pack lines (vials sterilised for direct use in operating theatres)
- Attend to breakdowns and troubleshoot faults across equipment, critical systems, and services, escalating to external contractors when a fault is beyond in-house scope
- Investigate and report breakdown root causes and concerns to management
- Ensure adherence to the preventative maintenance schedule
- Document all work and maintain accurate records in the CMMS within a cGMP-compliant change control environment
- Coordinate maintenance and repair activities with external service providers as required

What You'll Also Do

- Follow standard operating procedures in all work performed
- Complete GMP-standard documentation for work activities
- Contribute to the development of procedures and related documentation
- Support investigations into incidents, accidents, quality, and governance issues as needed
- Work collaboratively across Production, R&D, NPI, Validation, and QA/QC to support business objectives
- Identify, assess, and control workplace hazards and risks
- Report any accidents or incidents on the day they occur

 About You

- Mechanically minded, with proven maintenance technician experience in a regulated pharmaceutical environment
- Liquid filling / sterile injectable manufacturing experience strongly preferred; solid dose (tablet) experience will also be considered
- Food manufacturing background is not a fit for this role
- Working knowledge of CMMS platforms
- Exposure to equipment commissioning and validation processes
- Strong troubleshooting and fault-finding skills across mechanical, electrical, or utilities systems (purified water systems, vision systems, packaging lines)
- Comfortable working to GMP/cGMP standards and change control processes
- A collaborative approach and willingness to train and support colleagues
- Strong commitment to workplace health and safety
- No formal pharma qualification required — full training and support provided; the business will also consider candidates straight out of a mechanical apprenticeship


 Why Apply

- Direct, regular exposure to senior leadership including the CEO — a level of access not typical at larger multinational manufacturers
- Genuinely low staff turnover and a stable, tenured team culture
- Ongoing investment in new equipment and cleanroom upgrades
- Structured onboarding alongside a senior technician
- Company-supported training courses (up to $2,000) and career development, including pathways for apprentice-level candidates
- A growing, internationally expanding business with export markets beyond Australia

Interested in learning more? Apply now or reach out for a confidential conversation.

The role will suit a Senior Interior Designer who enjoys working at pace, taking ownership of projects and moving seamlessly between concept design, design development and detailed Revit documentation.

The Role
You will be responsible for running multiple workplace projects from design through to delivery, working closely with clients, consultants, builders and internal teams.

You will be involved in:
  • Leading workplace projects from concept through to documentation and delivery
  • Developing workplace concepts, layouts, test fits and design solutions

  • Working within a D&C-style environment, responding quickly to project requirements and construction constraints
  • Managing multiple projects and deadlines simultaneously

  • Working closely with project managers, builders and contractors

About You We are looking for someone who is:
  • An experienced Senior Interior Designer with strong workplace experience
  • Highly proficient in Revit with the ability to independently produce detailed documentation
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced D&C or delivery-focused environment
  • Experienced running projects rather than purely contributing to design
  • Confident managing clients, consultants and contractors
  • Commercially aware and comfortable making practical design decisions
  • Organised, proactive and able to manage multiple deadlines
  • Someone who enjoys being hands-on with both design and documentation
This role would particularly suit someone who enjoys the combination of creative design + technical delivery and wants to work in an environment where projects move quickly.
 
ROLE 2 – Senior Interior Designer | Premium Workplace & Wellness Design-led studio | Workplace & Wellness | Team Leadership | High-End Projects

The second opportunity is with a high-end, design-focused interior studio delivering premium workplace, wellness and commercial interiors.
This is a more design-led environment, suited to a Senior Interior Designer who wants to take ownership of projects, lead teams and contribute to the creative direction of significant workplace projects.

The Role
You will take responsibility for projects across the full design lifecycle, from early concept through to detailed documentation and delivery.
You will be involved in:
  • Leading workplace and wellness projects from concept through to completion
  • Developing strong design concepts and design narratives
  • Leading and mentoring junior and mid-level designers
  • Managing project teams and coordinating workloads
  • Preparing presentations and presenting design concepts to clients
  • Developing detailed design and documentation packages
  • Producing and reviewing Revit documentation
  • Coordinating consultants and project stakeholders
  • Managing project programmes, deliverables and deadlines
  • Working closely with clients to understand their vision and requirements
  • Material, finishes, furniture and FF&E selection
  • Supporting project delivery and construction coordination
  • Maintaining design quality and consistency throughout the project
  • Contributing to the studio's broader design culture and creative direction
About You You will ideally have:
  • Strong experience within workplace interior design
  • Proven experience running projects independently
  • Strong conceptual and design development skills
  • Advanced Revit documentation capability
  • Experience leading or mentoring designers
  • Excellent client-facing and presentation skills
  • Strong understanding of workplace design principles
  • Experience coordinating consultants and contractors
  • A high level of attention to detail
  • A genuine passion for high-quality interior design
You don't need to be a traditional "Design Director" to be successful here. The studio is looking for someone who is hands-on, design-focused and capable of taking ownership of projects and people.
 
Which opportunity is right for you? What both opportunities offer Both studios offer the opportunity to work on high-quality Melbourne workplace projects, take genuine ownership of projects and have a significant impact on the finished product.

If you're a Senior Interior Designer who is looking for more responsibility, stronger project ownership and the opportunity to work across design, leadership and Revit documentation, we'd love to hear from you.

Why This Role Is Different
The business has traditionally delivered a significant volume of industrial construction, where projects can be relatively straightforward from a commercial and contractual perspective.

The new multi-storey projects introduce a different level of complexity, including:
  • Multiple levels and building interfaces
  • Greater design development
  • Increased consultant coordination
  • More complex subcontractor packages
  • Significant variation and change management
  • More involved services coordination
  • Greater client and consultant interaction
  • Design changes throughout construction
  • Increased commercial and programme implications
As a result, they are specifically looking for CAs who understand how to manage the commercial consequences of change, rather than simply administering straightforward subcontract packages.

The Role
Working closely with the Project Manager and site team, you will take responsibility for the commercial and contractual administration of your project.
Your responsibilities will include:
  • Managing subcontractor packages from procurement through to completion
  • Preparing and administering subcontracts and purchase orders
  • Reviewing subcontractor scopes and quotations
  • Managing progress claims and payment schedules
  • Assessing, negotiating and administering variations
  • Managing EOTs and contractual notices
  • Identifying the commercial impact of design and scope changes
  • Maintaining accurate cost reporting and forecasting
  • Managing RFIs and coordinating with consultants and subcontractors
  • Reviewing drawings, specifications and design changes
  • Supporting procurement and subcontractor negotiations
  • Maintaining project registers and commercial documentation
  • Working closely with the PM to maintain project budgets and programme
  • Supporting the project through to final account and handover
What We're Looking For The ideal candidate will have:
  • 4+ years' experience as a Contract Administrator
  • Strong commercial construction experience
  • Experience across multi-storey commercial, residential or mixed-use projects
  • Strong understanding of variations, EOTs, progress claims and subcontract administration
  • Experience managing design and scope changes
  • Strong procurement and subcontractor management skills
  • Ability to read and interpret drawings and specifications
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Strong commercial awareness and attention to detail
  • A proactive approach to identifying and resolving issues
If you're a CA looking to broaden your experience into more complex multi-storey construction and want to join a growing builder where you can have genuine ownership of your projects, this could be an excellent next step

  • Previous experience working for a mechanical contractor or building services contractor.
  • The ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • A practical understanding of how mechanical services are delivered on-site.
  • Excellent attention to detail and a proactive approach to problem solving.
Experience across commercial, industrial, healthcare, data centre or major infrastructure projects will be highly regarded.
 
What's on Offer?

  • Opportunity to lead and develop an established drafting team.
  • Join a growing Tier 2 mechanical contractor.
  • Genuine opportunity to influence systems and processes.
  • Exposure to major mechanical services projects.
  • Strong pipeline of work.
  • Supportive senior management team.
  • Long-term career progression.

You will work across all stages of the project, from planning and procurement through to construction and completion. The role will suit a commercially minded Project Manager who is comfortable operating in a complex civil environment and enjoys taking ownership of project outcomes.

  • Identify commercial risks, project constraints and opportunities at an early stage.
  • Manage variations, claims, contractual matters and client reporting.
  • Maintain productive relationships with government clients, consultants and key stakeholders.
  • Ensure project activities meet relevant safety, environmental, quality and contractual requirements.
  • Provide leadership and support to Project Engineers, Site Engineers and other project team members.
  • Contribute to project strategy and continuous improvement across the wider business.
What You'll Bring

job.title: MEP BIM Modeler
job.description:
BIM Modeler - Tier 1 MEP Contractor
Location: Melbourne, VIC
Salary: $110,000 - $125,000 + Super
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: MEP / Building Services / Data Centres
 
The Opportunity
We are currently working with a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor delivering major mechanical and electrical projects across Melbourne, including complex commercial, industrial and data centre developments.
Due to continued project growth, they are looking for an experienced BIM Modeler to join their project delivery team. This is an excellent opportunity to work on technically complex projects alongside experienced engineers, project managers and construction teams.
 
The Role
As a BIM Modeler, you will be responsible for developing, coordinating and maintaining high-quality BIM models throughout the project lifecycle.
You will work closely with engineering, design, project management and site teams to ensure models accurately reflect project requirements and are suitable for construction and installation.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Develop and maintain detailed MEP BIM models using Revit and associated modelling software.
  • Produce coordinated models and drawings for mechanical and/or electrical building services.
  • Work closely with engineers, project managers, subcontractors and site teams to resolve design and coordination issues.
  • Participate in BIM coordination and clash detection processes.
  • Review design information and identify potential constructability issues.
  • Assist with the preparation of shop drawings, fabrication information and construction documentation.
  • Maintain model accuracy and ensure deliverables meet project BIM standards and requirements.
  • Coordinate with architectural, structural and other services models.
  • Support project teams throughout design, construction and commissioning phases.
  • Contribute to BIM standards, processes and continuous improvement.
  • Attend coordination meetings and communicate modelling/design issues effectively.
About You
The successful candidate will ideally have:
  • Previous experience as a BIM Modeler within an MEP, mechanical, electrical or building services environment.
  • Strong proficiency in Revit.
  • Experience with Navisworks and clash detection/coordination.
  • Good understanding of mechanical and/or electrical building services.
  • Ability to interpret engineering drawings and technical documentation.
  • Experience working within a contractor, subcontractor or construction environment.
  • Strong attention to detail and an understanding of constructability.
  • Excellent communication and coordination skills.
  • Ability to work effectively within a fast-paced project environment.
Desirable Experience
Experience across any of the following would be highly regarded:
  • Data Centres / Mission Critical
  • Commercial construction
  • Industrial projects
  • High-rise developments
  • Large-scale infrastructure
  • Mechanical services
  • Electrical services
  • Fabrication modelling
  • Revit MEP
  • Navisworks Manage
Why Join?
  • Join an established Tier 1 MEP contractor.
  • Work on major, technically complex projects.
  • Exposure to some of Melbourne's largest construction and data centre developments.
  • Strong career progression into BIM Coordinator / BIM Manager positions.
  • Work alongside experienced engineering and project delivery teams.
  • Competitive salary of $110,000 - $125,000 + Super, depending on experience.
Apply
If you're an experienced BIM Modeler looking to take the next step with a leading MEP contractor, we'd like to hear from you.
Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

job.title: Senior Electrical Project Engineer
job.description:
Senior Electrical Engineer - Tier 1 MEP Contractor
Location: Melbourne, VIC
Salary: $155,000 - $180,000 + Super
Employment Type: Full-time
Sector: MEP / Building Services / Data Centres
 
The Opportunity
We are representing a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor delivering major mechanical and electrical projects across Melbourne.
Due to continued growth and a strong project pipeline, they are looking to appoint an experienced Senior Electrical Engineer to join their project delivery team.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced electrical engineer to work on technically complex projects, taking ownership of electrical packages while working closely with project managers, construction teams, consultants and subcontractors.
The Role
As a Senior Electrical Engineer, you will play a key role in the technical delivery of major MEP projects, ensuring electrical works are coordinated, technically compliant and delivered to the required quality, programme and commercial standards.
You will be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from design coordination and procurement through to installation, testing and commissioning.
 
Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the technical delivery of electrical packages across major construction projects.
  • Review electrical designs, specifications, drawings and technical documentation.
  • Coordinate electrical services with mechanical, architectural, structural and other disciplines.
  • Work closely with consultants, subcontractors, suppliers and internal project teams.
  • Identify and resolve technical, design and constructability issues.
  • Review shop drawings, technical submissions, RFIs and design changes.
  • Support procurement and subcontractor management for electrical packages.
  • Monitor installation against approved designs, specifications and project requirements.
  • Assist with project programming, sequencing and technical planning.
  • Support testing, commissioning and handover activities.
  • Ensure works comply with relevant Australian Standards, codes and project specifications.
  • Provide technical guidance and mentoring to junior engineers and project team members.
  • Attend design, coordination, construction and client meetings.
  • Assist the Project Manager and wider project team with technical and commercial decision-making.
  • Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure engineering deliverables are completed on schedule.
About You
The successful candidate will ideally have:
  • A Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or equivalent.
  • Strong experience working within MEP, building services or construction environments.
  • Proven experience delivering electrical packages on medium to large-scale projects.
  • Strong understanding of electrical building services and construction methodologies.
  • Excellent knowledge of electrical design, coordination and installation.
  • Experience working with consultants, subcontractors and Tier 1 contractors.
  • Strong understanding of Australian Standards and relevant electrical codes.
  • Excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder management skills.
  • The ability to work autonomously while contributing effectively to a wider project team.
  • Strong commercial and problem-solving awareness.
Desirable Experience
Experience across any of the following would be highly regarded:
  • Data Centres / Mission Critical
  • Commercial construction
  • Industrial projects
  • High-rise developments
  • Healthcare
  • Infrastructure
  • Critical power systems
  • HV/LV electrical systems
  • UPS and generator systems
  • Switchboards and distribution systems
  • Electrical testing and commissioning
  • Revit / BIM coordination
  • Tier 1 MEP contractor experience
What You'll Receive
  • $155,000 - $180,000 + Super, depending on experience.
  • Opportunity to join a leading Tier 1 MEP contractor.
  • Exposure to major Melbourne projects and technically complex environments.
  • Significant exposure to data centre and mission-critical projects.
  • Clear progression into Lead Engineer, Project Manager and Engineering Management positions.
  • Work alongside highly experienced project delivery and engineering teams.
  • Long-term career stability with a strong project pipeline.
Apply

Apply now or contact us for a confidential discussion about the opportunity.

We are currently working with a growing civil contractor that has just secured a record amount of new work, following a number of successful tender wins across the region.

With a strong pipeline of upcoming projects, they are looking to add an experienced Civil Supervisor to their team to help deliver a range of civil infrastructure and subdivision projects across SEQ. 

This is an excellent opportunity to join a contractor at an exciting stage of growth, with plenty of work secured and further projects in the pipeline.
The Role You will be responsible for:
  • Supervising day-to-day civil construction activities across infrastructure and subdivision projects
  • Leading site crews, subcontractors and plant to ensure projects are delivered safely and efficiently
  • Managing site productivity, sequencing, materials and resources
  • Reading and interpreting drawings, specifications and construction documentation
  • Working closely with Project Managers and Engineers to achieve programme, quality and cost targets
  • Ensuring all works are completed in accordance with safety, environmental and quality requirements
  • Identifying and resolving site issues as they arise
  • Maintaining strong relationships with clients, subcontractors and other project stakeholders
What We're Looking For The successful candidate will have:
  • Previous experience as a Civil Supervisor / Foreman within civil construction
  • Strong experience across civil infrastructure, subdivisions, earthworks, roads, drainage and associated works
  • A strong understanding of construction methodologies and site sequencing
  • Ability to lead crews and subcontractors effectively
  • Strong communication and organisational skills
  • A safety-first approach and commitment to quality
  • Relevant tickets/qualifications within civil construction are advantageous
What's On Offer
  • Join a contractor experiencing significant growth
  • Record amount of new tenders recently secured
  • Strong pipeline of civil infrastructure and subdivision projects
  • Projects located across the Ipswich to Lockyer Valley corridor
  • Competitive salary package based on experience
  • Opportunity to work with an experienced project team
  • Long-term stability and career progression
Interested? If you're a Civil Supervisor currently working in the SEQ Region and are open to hearing about a new opportunity, apply now or contact Jimmy Stewart on 0423 611 276 or jstewart@designandbuild.com.au.

job.title: Project Manager
job.description:
We are seeking an experienced Project Manager with a proven track record delivering Roads projects in QLD and NSW 

Key Responsibilities
  • Lead the end-to-end delivery of TMR infrastructure projects from planning and design through construction, commissioning and handover.
  • Manage project scope, budgets, programs, procurement, contracts, risks and quality requirements.
  • Coordinate contractors, subcontractors, consultants, designers and internal project teams.
  • Ensure projects are delivered in accordance with TMR specifications, standards, contractual requirements and Queensland regulatory obligations.
  • Manage project reporting, forecasting, cost control, variations and change management.
  • Identify and resolve project risks, issues and constraints to maintain project outcomes.
  • Maintain effective relationships with TMR representatives, government stakeholders, contractors, consultants and other project stakeholders.
  • Lead project meetings and provide clear reporting on progress, commercial performance, risks and key deliverables.
  • Ensure strong WHS, environmental, quality and compliance outcomes across all project activities.
About You

You will be an experienced infrastructure Project Manager with demonstrated, hands-on experience delivering TMR projects in Queensland.

To be considered, you will have:
  • Proven TMR project delivery experience.
  • Demonstrated experience managing major civil infrastructure, transport or road projects.
  • Strong understanding of TMR specifications, standards, processes and project requirements.
  • Experience managing project budgets, programs, contracts, variations and commercial outcomes.
  • Proven ability to manage contractors, consultants and multidisciplinary teams.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, particularly within government and transport infrastructure environments.
  • Excellent communication, reporting and negotiation skills.
  • Relevant qualifications in Project Management, Engineering, Construction Management or a related discipline.
  • A strong understanding of Queensland construction, safety, environmental and regulatory requirements.
If you are an experience project manager or Senior Project Engineer ready to step up click apply or reach out to Jimmy Stewart on 0423 611 276 or jstewart@designandbuild.com.au

job.title: Construction Project Manager
job.description:
We are currently working exclusively a highly regarded Melbourne-based property developer and builder, to appoint an experienced Project Manager to join their in-house construction team.

An award-winning organisation that takes a fully integrated approach to property development, with architecture, interior design, construction, project management, sales, marketing, operations and asset management all managed in-house.

This is an exciting opportunity for a Project Manager to take ownership of a multi-residential apartment development in South-East Melbourne, working closely with an experienced construction and senior leadership team.

Location: South-East Melbourne / Melbourne CBD
Position: Project Manager
Sector: Multi-Residential / Apartments
Employment: Permanent
Start: September 2026
Salary: Up to $160,000 + Super

The Opportunity
You will play a key role in managing the project from pre-construction and tendering through to construction delivery and final handover.

The role will be hands-on and varied, providing exposure across estimating, procurement, contracts administration, cost management, subcontractor coordination and project delivery.

Key Responsibilities
  • Manage the project through the full construction lifecycle
  • Assist with estimating, tender preparation and subcontractor procurement
  • Manage subcontractor engagement, performance and delivery
  • Oversee contracts administration and project documentation
  • Monitor project costs, budgets and financial performance
  • Manage construction programs and project milestones
  • Coordinate consultants, subcontractors and key project stakeholders
  • Provide hands-on support to the site team and ensure project requirements are met
  • Maintain strong standards across quality, compliance, safety and documentation
  • Assist with project reporting and general project administration
  • Drive the successful delivery of the project through to completion and handover

About You
We are looking for an experienced and driven Project Manager with approximately 3–5 years' experience in a Project Management capacity.
Ideally, you will have a background delivering multi-residential or apartment developments, with experience on projects involving:
  • Basement construction
  • Approximately 5–7 storeys
  • Complex subcontractor packages
  • Full project lifecycle delivery
  • Tendering and procurement
  • Contracts administration
  • Cost and financial management

Requirements
  • 3–5 years' experience as a Project Manager
  • Demonstrated experience delivering multi-residential/apartment projects
  • Relevant Diploma of Building & Construction, Construction Management or Project Management degree
  • Strong understanding of construction methodology, contracts and project delivery
  • Strong commercial and cost management capability
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
  • Ability to manage multiple priorities and work autonomously
  • Experience with CostX, Microsoft Project, Sage Intacct, BuildPass or Bluebeam will be highly regarded.  

Interested?
If you are an experienced Project Manager looking for your next opportunity with a reputable developer/builder and want to take ownership of a quality Melbourne residential project, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Interior Designer
job.description:
Interior Designer | Multi-Residential

We are seeking a talented and detail-focused Interior Designer to join our Brisbane design team, working across our multi-residential portfolio and contributing to the development of our brand within the market.

This role will sit across design, documentation and FF&E, supporting projects from concept through to delivery. You will work closely with the senior design team to develop considered, commercially viable interiors that are aligned with our brand, design principles and project requirements.

Key Responsibilities
  • Contribute to the development and delivery of interior design projects across the multi-residential sector, from concept through to construction.
  • Develop and maintain comprehensive FF&E packages, including furniture, lighting, finishes, artwork and accessories.
  • Develop design concepts, material and colour palettes, finishes, furniture, lighting, artwork and accessories.
  • Prepare FF&E schedules, specifications and procurement information.
  • Coordinate interior design, documentation and FF&E packages with architects, consultants, builders, suppliers and other project stakeholders.
About You 
  • A degree or relevant qualification in Interior Design or Interior Architecture.
  • 4+ years' professional experience in the multi-residential, hospitality, or mixed use space.
  • Experienced in developing interior documentation and FF&E packages.
  • Strong design sensibility and an appreciation for high-quality materials, detailing and finishes.
  • Highly organised and can operate multiple projects at a time.
  • High attention to detail and the ability to develop design concepts into accurate, coordinated and buildable packages.
The successful candidate will be confident taking a design direction and developing it into a cohesive, detailed and buildable interior package.
Up to $110k Salary package for the right candidate. 

If you think that you could be a good fit for this position, please apply directly to this add or contact Brittany Steinbach on 0401 205 618 
/ bsteinbach@designandbuild.com.au 
Your application will be treated as strictly confidential.

Thanks for your consideration.

job.title: DIDO Civil Supervisor - 10:4 or 2:1
job.description:
This Perth based civil contractor delivers complex road and infrastructure works across Western Australia, with a strong focus on profiling, milling and civil construction. Known for high safety standards, modern plant and disciplined project delivery, the business works with both government and private clients on repeat engagements.

Leaders are trusted to run their projects properly, supported by capable crews, clear systems and a stable pipeline of work. It is an environment suited to experienced Project Managers and Supervisors who value accountability, teamwork and delivering quality outcomes on site.
  
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Civil Supervisor with 4 to 5 years of hands on road construction experience to join projects across regional WA including Main Roads and CBH intersections. This is a practical on site role where you will oversee crews, plant and subcontractors to ensure projects are completed safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
  
The role operates on a 10:4 or 2:1 roster with accommodation and meal allowance provided.
  
About You
  • Hands on experience supervising road construction projects
  • Skilled at managing crews, plant and subcontractors on sit
  • Able to support and guide junior staff in their daily tasks
  • Strong commitment to safety, quality and efficient work practices
  • Practical, approachable and fair but firm in your leadership approach
Skills and Experience
  • 4 to 5 years supervising civil infrastructure or road construction projects
  • Proven ability to manage site operations including labour, plant and subcontractors
  • Focused on safe, efficient and high quality project delivery
  • Comfortable working on a 10 days on 4 days off roster in the South West
  • Hands on problem solver with a practical approach to challenges on site
Benefits:
  • Accommodation provided while on site
  • $70 daily meal allowance
  • Work on varied and high profile road construction projects
  • Project autonomy and the ability to take ownership of site delivery
  • Opportunity to lead and develop junior engineers
  • Competitive Salary and company vehicle.
If you feel your experience matches the person specification please contact click apply. For any questions about the role, please contact Reece Saldaris at Reece@designandbuild.com.au or 0431 555 104 for a confidential chat.

job.title: Senior HVAC Project Manager
job.description:
Senior HVAC Project Manager

Working with an established and highly respected building services organisation delivering HVAC&R solutions across major commercial property portfolios throughout Australia. The business has extensive experience across construction, fit-outs, refurbishments, engineering and long-term asset management, with a strong presence across the commercial and retail sectors.

The Opportunity

An exciting opportunity is available for an experienced Senior HVAC Project Manager to take ownership of a major $10m mechanical HVAC refurbishment project within a large shopping centre.

This is a long-term opportunity with a strong pipeline of projects behind it. The successful candidate will need to be more than technically capable — they need to be commercially sharp, confident managing builders and consultants, and comfortable taking ownership of project outcomes.

You will be responsible for managing the project from commencement through to completion, while building strong relationships with the builder, client and wider project team.

Key Perks & Benefits
  • Up to $180k + super + car / car allowance
  • Major $10m mechanical refurbishment project to take ownership of
  • Long-term pipeline of HVAC projects
  • Opportunity to work across major commercial, retail and refurbishment projects
  • Join an established business with a strong reputation in the building services market
  • Genuine opportunity for career progression and long-term stability
Key Responsibilities
  • Take full ownership of the delivery and commercial management of major HVAC projects
  • Manage budgets, procurement, variations, forecasting, subcontractors and project reporting
  • Build and maintain strong relationships with builders, clients, consultants and key stakeholders
  • Manage builder expectations and resolve commercial, technical and programme issues throughout the project
  • Lead project teams to ensure works are delivered safely, on time, within budget and to the required quality standards
Key Requirements
  • Proven experience as a Senior HVAC Project Manager / Project Manager within the commercial construction sector
  • Strong commercial capability, with a proven understanding of budgets, variations, forecasting, procurement and project margins
  • Demonstrated experience delivering new builds, commercial fit-outs and major refurbishments
  • Strong understanding of HVAC/mechanical services and the ability to confidently manage builders, consultants and subcontractors
  • Excellent communication, negotiation and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to take ownership and drive project outcomes
This is an excellent opportunity for a commercially strong HVAC Project Manager who wants to take ownership of major projects and join a business with a significant long-term pipeline.

To set up a confidential call, apply now or email your CV to louis@designandbuild.com.au

job.title: HVAC Estimators
job.description:
HVAC Estimator

The Opportunity An exciting opportunity has become available with a well-established and highly respected HVAC contractor that is continuing to expand into the Tier 1 market.

The business delivers technically complex HVAC projects across commercial, industrial, healthcare, data centres and education, working across both Tier 2 and Tier 1 environments. Due to a significant increase in tender opportunities, they are looking to expand their estimating team and are open to Junior, Intermediate and Senior HVAC Estimators.

This is a fantastic opportunity to work on landmark projects and highly technical D&C developments, with the backing of an experienced estimating team. Junior Estimators will also be supported and trained by senior members of the team, making this an excellent environment to develop your estimating career.

  • Develop detailed cost estimates, including labour, materials, plant and subcontractor costs

  • Experience in HVAC estimating, ideally within a commercial contracting environment
  • Strong understanding of HVAC systems, construction methodologies and project delivery
  • Ability to interpret technical drawings, specifications and tender documentation
  • Strong attention to detail with excellent numerical and analytical skills

  • Senior Estimators earning up to $180k + super

job.title: HR/IR Manager - Major Infrastructure Project | FIFO
job.description:
About the opportunity
This is a senior, site-based leadership position responsible for managing the HR and Industrial Relations function across a large and complex construction workforce. You will lead an established HR/IR team while partnering closely with senior project leadership, unions, subcontractors and key stakeholders.

This is a FIFO position and will suit an experienced HR/IR professional comfortable operating in a major project environment.

The Role Reporting to the senior People & Culture leadership team, you will take ownership of HR and IR delivery across site, including:
  • Lead and develop a team of HR/IR professionals, including Senior Advisors, Advisors and Officers.
  • Provide expert advice across industrial relations, employee relations and workplace legislation.
  • Interpret and apply Enterprise Agreements, Awards, employment contracts and relevant legislation.
  • Manage union relationships, right-of-entry matters, industrial disputes and complex negotiations.
  • Partner with site leadership on performance management, misconduct, disciplinary matters and workforce issues.
  • Oversee complex HR/IR case management and ensure matters are resolved practically and commercially.
  • Identify emerging workforce and industrial risks and implement appropriate mitigation strategies.
  • Build strong relationships across project leadership, subcontractors, unions and external stakeholders.
  • Support HR systems, payroll interpretation, reporting and broader workforce initiatives.
About You
We are looking for a highly experienced HR/IR professional who has operated in complex, heavily unionised construction or major infrastructure environments.
Ideally, you will bring:
  • 12+ years' HR and Industrial Relations experience.
  • Major construction, infrastructure, resources or similarly complex project experience.
  • Demonstrated experience leading HR/IR teams.
  • Strong exposure to multi-union environments.
  • Significant experience with Fair Work Commission matters, dispute resolution and complex negotiations.
  • Strong knowledge of the Fair Work Act, Enterprise Agreements, Awards and workplace relations legislation.
  • Confidence dealing directly with senior leadership, unions and a diverse blue- and white-collar workforce.
  • Tertiary qualifications in HR, Employment Relations, Law, Organisational Psychology or a related discipline.
  • White Card and current driver's licence.
This is an opportunity to take on a high-profile HR/IR leadership position within a major Australian infrastructure environment, with genuine responsibility for workforce strategy, industrial relations and site culture.
You will be joining a large-scale project where strong IR capability, practical leadership and the ability to operate confidently at site level are critical.
FIFO arrangements apply.

If you are an experienced HR/IR leader from major construction or infrastructure and are interested in discussing the opportunity confidentially, apply now or contact Renee Hamilton at Design & Build Recruitment for a confidential conversation.
